title: C4OS Grill Question 045 - Model Attachment Compatibility

questions.label: How should C4OS handle model/provider attachment differences?
questions.help: Recommended: store C4OS-owned attachment records first; runtime/provider adapters translate or degrade per model capability.
options: Store C4OS attachment records; adapters translate or degrade per model
Only allow attachments when the selected provider supports direct attachments
Convert all attachments to prompt text
Block attachments until every provider supports them

questions.label: What should happen when a selected model cannot consume an attachment directly?
questions.help: Recommended: show a visible compatibility warning and let the adapter use the best safe fallback, such as text summary, extracted text, path reference, or screenshot description.
options: Warn visibly and use best safe adapter fallback
Send anyway and let provider fail

questions.label: Which provider/model path should the first attachment proof target?
questions.help: Recommended: use the current OpenAI-compatible provider path first, then document provider-specific gaps before expanding.

questions.label: Which attachment types need first proof coverage?
questions.help: Recommended: files, Browser screenshots, and Browser annotation attachments because those are already accepted first-pass attachment types.
options: Files, Browser screenshots, and Browser annotation attachments
Files, screenshots, annotations, directories, and artifacts

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify provider priority, multimodal limits, text extraction, binary files, max size, token budget, or whether unsupported attachment warnings should block approval.
